observations: A mouth in the lower right shows rows of pointed white teeth between red-and-yellow striped lips, with a dark opening visible behind the teeth and heavy black outlines framing the jaw.
Yellow looping forms arc across the top of the head, layered over teal and black tangled lines that build a dense crown-like mass.
Two rectangular shapes sit mid-face, cross-hatched in red and black with white fills, framed by heavy black outlines against a flat purple field.
reading: The face breaks open at the jaw, baring sharp white teeth that drag the composition downward and to the right. Thick black lines tangle with bright yellow loops and teal threads, building a head that seems to vibrate against the still purple ground. The effect reads as a shout caught mid-release—something between fury and laughter, held together by the density of overlapping marks.
contextAngle: In the owned rawblocks subset, this work sits between #45 and #47. All three feature exposed teeth and tangled line work, but this piece stands apart with its saturated purple ground and the density of color layers packed into the face.

connections.reason: Both show bared teeth and a profile-like tilt, but #45 uses a dark green field and sparse pink outlines where #46 fills every gap with competing color.
Both place a face against purple with cross-hatched eye areas, but nnotb #190 packs its marks into a rounder, more contained mass.

lookingQuestion: Where does the yellow outline separate from the black scaffolding, and how does that gap change the sense of depth across the face?
ambiguities: Whether the rectangular mid-face shapes represent glasses or eyes alone is unclear from the image.
The yellow loops at the top could be read as hair, a headdress, or pure abstract mark-making.
